gameDescriptionHtml:
Exorcism Agency is an innovative roguelike that makes horror downright fun.You can easily and joyfully experience a bizarre journey of intimate contact with a ghost girl in the game,good luck!

We’ve blended the classic match-3 mechanic into roguelike deckbuilding game,where different effect ghost’s cards randomly take on various colors and are inserted into the battle track, making card battles more dynamic.Players need to play their cards to eliminate the ghosts on the track,and complete the tasks as quickly as possible!

Players can achieve exciting combos through thoughtful construction;combos can earn more rewards, which can be used for various shop services.

Every exorcist needs to plan their cards wisely to achieve a fatal blow!

Game Features

  • In-depth Exorcism, Exploring the Unknown Secrets Deep Within. Every exorcism task is unique. At the crossroads, players need to decide based on their current situation whether to confront the powerful ghosts head-on, explore the unknown, or avoid danger and take a moment to rest. We believe that everyone will be able to break the curse from the fog and choose the right path in the mysterious unknown events.
  • Rich Instruments, Use Your Creativity to Build Your Exorcism Style. Ritual instruments are powerful helpers on the path of exorcism. Players can obtain different instruments by facing ghosts, collecting supply chests, and purchasing supplies. The form and function of instruments are different, and different classes can use different instruments. Players can flexibly match various instruments and charms to using their strengths and build their own genre. Maximize our chances of surviving the ghost group. Remember: You must make good use of the props and instruments in your hand to have a chance to go out while alive!
  • Deadly Charm, Even Ghost Girls Will Surrender to Me. Die under the peony flowers, are even ghosts also romantic? Better to die under a peony than live without romance, right? When facing the ghost girl BOSS, please don’t indulge in beauty and be sucked out of your life. Rely on your deck, clear the spirit track, and take down dangerous spirits one by one. Some ghost girls will scream or even have their clothes rip as their health drops (seduction still won’t save them)! Take advantage of the victory, exorcists, and find the right time to launch a fatal blow against the ghost girl!
  • Command the Ghost, Let Ghost Girls Power You Up. Defeat a dangerous ghost, the “ghost larva” will automatically be stored in your Ghost Nursery. Players can cultivate them to gain extra abilities. Bringing the right ghost larva into battle, grants special buffs. At the same time, higher favorability will also unlock more unique ability effects and various mysterious collectibles. Carrying different ghost larvae will also have different negative effects, so be sure to choose carefully! In the Ghost Nursery, players can also unlock free clothes explosion and a camera system. Note: Dangerous ghosts also has their favorite food, feeding their favorite sacrifices can greatly increase favorability. In the process of exorcism, each battle victory will get a different sacrifice. It’s time to head out and work hard to raise a ghost girl.~
  • Free Customization, Make the Decision about Your Own Look. There is no limit to pinching the face, players can make their own physical in the lobby, not only hand-drawn, but also upload pictures, and DIY kill sound, which can be displayed in battle. The self-made look can also be taken with the ghost girl in the Ghost Nursery, is it a beautiful ghost with a handsome man, or …… Hey, it is up to you!
  • Horror Stories to Share, Tales from the Exorcism. Players can browse various horror stories in the game’s exclusive “Exorcism Record”, and can also leave messages about their own experiences and horror stories. This section welcomes you to freely create urban legends, nightmare tales, and also welcome to tell your real experiences or anecdotes, adding a bit of realism to our exorcism internship career!
